headline: Las Vegas GP: Verstappen wins 75th career race through 35 lead changes as McLaren take double podium
whyCareReason: Verstappen commands P2 in the standings on 304 points while McLaren slash Red Bull lead for P3 in the Constructors to just 9 points.
teaser: Max Verstappen captures his 4th win of 2026 by 0.639s over Lando Norris while Oscar Piastri charges from P17 to 3rd after late Mercedes drama.
story:
Max Verstappen delivered a classic desert victory under the Las Vegas Strip lights on Saturday night, 21 November, conquering 35 changes for the lead to claim his 4th win of the 2026 season and 75th Grand Prix triumph overall.

Heavy slipstreaming kept the pack bunched across 50 intense laps. Late heartbreak hit Mercedes when George Russell crashed into the barriers on Lap 48 and newly crowned champion Kimi Antonelli suffered a power issue, clearing the path for Lando Norris to chase Verstappen within 0.639 seconds at the flag. Oscar Piastri produced the drive of the night to charge from 17th on the grid onto the final podium step.

Ferrari endurance faltered late when Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc made contact, finishing 7th and 10th respectively, leaving McLaren just nine points behind Red Bull heading into Qatar.
stakes: Antonelli holds 402 points as champion; Verstappen locks down 304; Hamilton (267), Russell (264), and Norris (264) sit three points apart.
rivalryAngle: Late Mercedes carnage saw George Russell hit the barrier on Lap 48 and Kimi Antonelli suffer a sudden power loss while fighting up front.
funFacts: Verstappen earned his third Las Vegas Grand Prix victory in four years and 75th career win.
The 50-lap neon race produced an astonishing 35 lead changes through active aerodynamic slipstreaming.
Oscar Piastri surged from P17 on the grid to claim 3rd place behind McLaren teammate Lando Norris.
